items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 70:1
items.html: In the ZAT of Nekudim that broke and fell into BYA, three phases are discerned in them: lights, sparks, and vessels. From their vessels the three cavities of Galgalta were made. From their sparks the membranes for the Mochin were made. And from their lights the Mochin themselves were made. (Item 97)
